name: current-base-deterministic-mock-required-Metadata-003
notes: Current-base Metadata-003 covers only the 42 queue rows not already present in existing fixture evidence. The source exercises local Omni configuration fields, platform action DTOs/enums, operations construction, and primary-tab collections.
salesforceExclusionReason: The current Salesforce compile oracle does not accept the Metadata DTO surface in this lane; this fixture records local deterministic-mock construction and member behavior only and makes no Salesforce compile claim.

source.content: @isTest private class CurrentBaseDeterministicMockRequiredMetadata003Test { @isTest static void metadata003Witness() { Metadata.OmniInteractionAccessConfig config = new Metadata.OmniInteractionAccessConfig(); config.configName = 'Omni'; config.isAsyncCardCachingEnabled = false; config.isCardApexRemoteDisabled = true; config.isCardCacheDisabled = false; config.isCardDataTfrmDisabled = true; config.isCardIntegrationProcDisabled = false; config.isCardRestApiDisabled = true; config.isCardSoqlDisabled = false; config.isCardSoslDisabled = true; config.isCardStreamingApiDisabled = false; config.isDataTfrmEncrpFieldsDisabled = true; config.masterLabel = 'Fixture config'; config.setupOwner = 'User'; System.assertEquals('Omni', config.configName); System.assertEquals(true, config.isCardApexRemoteDisabled); System.assertEquals('Fixture config', config.masterLabel); Metadata.OmniInteractionAccessConfig configClone = (Metadata.OmniInteractionAccessConfig)config.clone(); System.assertNotEquals(config, configClone); System.assertEquals('Omni', configClone.configName); Metadata.Operations operations = new Metadata.Operations(); System.assertNotEquals(null, operations); Metadata.Operations operationsClone = (Metadata.Operations)operations.clone(); System.assertNotEquals(operations, operationsClone); Metadata.PlatformActionList actionList = new Metadata.PlatformActionList(); actionList.actionListContext = Metadata.PlatformActionListContextEnum.Record; actionList.relatedSourceEntity = 'Account'; Metadata.PlatformActionListItem action = new Metadata.PlatformActionListItem(); action.actionName = 'Account.New'; action.actionType = Metadata.PlatformActionTypeEnum.QuickAction; action.sortOrder = 1; action.subtype = 'Standard'; actionList.platformActionListItems = new List<Metadata.PlatformActionListItem>{action}; System.assertEquals('Account.New', actionList.platformActionListItems[0].actionName); System.assertEquals(1, actionList.platformActionListItems[0].sortOrder); Metadata.PlatformActionListItem actionClone = (Metadata.PlatformActionListItem)action.clone(); System.assertNotEquals(action, actionClone); System.assertEquals('Account.New', actionClone.actionName); Metadata.PlatformActionList actionListClone = (Metadata.PlatformActionList)actionList.clone(); System.assertNotEquals(actionList, actionListClone); System.assertEquals('Account', actionListClone.relatedSourceEntity); Metadata.PlatformActionListContextEnum context = Metadata.PlatformActionListContextEnum.Record; System.assertEquals(true, context.equals(Metadata.PlatformActionListContextEnum.valueOf('Record'))); System.assertNotEquals(null, context.hashCode()); System.assert(context.ordinal() >= 0); System.assert(Metadata.PlatformActionListContextEnum.values().size() > 0); Metadata.PlatformActionTypeEnum actionType = Metadata.PlatformActionTypeEnum.QuickAction; System.assertEquals(true, actionType.equals(Metadata.PlatformActionTypeEnum.valueOf('QuickAction'))); System.assertNotEquals(null, actionType.hashCode()); System.assert(actionType.ordinal() >= 0); System.assert(Metadata.PlatformActionTypeEnum.values().size() > 0); Metadata.PrimaryTabComponents primary = new Metadata.PrimaryTabComponents(); primary.component = new List<Metadata.ConsoleComponent>{new Metadata.ConsoleComponent()}; primary.containers = new List<Metadata.Container>{new Metadata.Container()}; System.assertEquals(1, primary.component.size()); System.assertEquals(1, primary.containers.size()); Metadata.PrimaryTabComponents primaryClone = (Metadata.PrimaryTabComponents)primary.clone(); System.assertNotEquals(primary, primaryClone); System.assertEquals(1, primaryClone.component.size()); Metadata.QuickActionList quickActions = new Metadata.QuickActionList(); quickActions.quickActionListItems = new List<Metadata.QuickActionListItem>{new Metadata.QuickActionListItem()}; Metadata.QuickActionList quickActionsClone = (Metadata.QuickActionList)quickActions.clone(); System.assertNotEquals(quickActions, quickActionsClone); System.assertEquals(1, quickActionsClone.quickActionListItems.size()); } }
